description: Catalog of environment variable secrets with env var mappings. Generated by apply scripts from decrypted system.yml; consumed by sops.nix and ai.nix at Nix evaluation time.

keys.description: List of environment variable catalog entries. Each entry maps a SOPS secret name to the environment variable it should be exported as.

name.description: SOPS secret name with env_ prefix (e.g. env_key_ai_openrouter, env_redis_password).

envVar.description: Environment variable name: env_ prefix stripped and uppercased (env_key_ai_foo → KEY_AI_FOO, env_redis_password → REDIS_PASSWORD).
